title: 2FA Bypass via Self-Service TOTP Secret Exposure
proof: 1) Registered user worker_user_1744857566@test.com (POST /api/Users). 2) Logged in, got JWT. 3) GET /rest/2fa/status returned secret=24OLLTAN5W5BECFM3I2QZFJUJ7IDCDJ4 and setupToken (even though setup=false). 4) Generated TOTP 388777 via Python TOTP implementation. 5) POST /rest/2fa/setup with {password, initialToken:388777, setupToken} returned 200 (2FA enabled). 6) POST /rest/user/login returned totp_token_required with tmpToken. 7) POST /rest/2fa/verify with {tmpToken, totpToken:854142} returned new JWT. 8) GET /rest/user/whoami with new token returned user identity (id:40, email:worker_user_1744857566@test.com) proving authenticated session.
